description: This file defines various type guards and type assertions related to ContentReference types, including legacy references and tag-to-parent-tag references within a content management system.

methods.name: isLegacyAnonymousReference
methods.description: Type guard function to check if a ContentReference is a LegacyAnonymousReference, based on the absence of a reference_type property.

methods.name: isReference
methods.description: Type guard function to check if a ContentReference is a Reference, based on the presence of a reference_type property.

methods.name: isLegacyTagToNoteReference
methods.description: Type guard function to determine if a LegacyAnonymousReference is a LegacyTagToNoteReference, based on content_type and the current item's content_type.

methods.name: isTagToParentTagReference
methods.description: Type guard function to check if a ContentReference is a TagToParentTagReference, based on the reference_type.

ctags.name: isLegacyAnonymousReference
ctags.pattern: /^export const isLegacyAnonymousReference = (x: ContentReference): x is LegacyAnonymousReference =/

ctags.name: isReference
ctags.pattern: /^export const isReference = (x: ContentReference): x is Reference => {$/

ctags.name: isTagToParentTagReference
ctags.pattern: /^export const isTagToParentTagReference = (x: ContentReference): x is TagToParentTagReference => /
